title: A GraphQL server with AppSync's schema
description:
As a web app using the real `aws-amplify` client, I want a local server that answers the same GraphQL schema as AppSync, so that the app runs without AWS.

```gherkin
Feature: AppSync-compatible GraphQL
  Scenario: The server's schema is the AppSync schema
    Given a server started with the SDL fixture "blog.graphql" and its contract
    When I fetch the introspection schema
    Then it equals the SDL after normalization

  Scenario: A mutation then a query
    When I send mutation createPost with input {"title": "Hi"} selecting id and title
    And I send query getPost with that id selecting title
    Then data.getPost.title is "Hi"

  Scenario: Errors use AppSync's envelope
    When I send createPost twice with the same id
    Then data.createPost is null and errors[0].errorType is "DynamoDB:ConditionalCheckFailedException"
```
